entities.summary: Alessio di Mauro is a former professional tennis player from Italy. During his career, he reached the final of one ATP tournament, the 2007 ATP Buenos Aires. On 26 February 2007 the left-hander reached his career high ranking of world no. 68. Alessio di Mauro was a athletes & competitors from Syracuse (b. 1977-08-09, Syracuse). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
